name: Client collateral design system baseline
why_it_works: Forces approved inputs before production and prevents after-the-fact QA of generic generated assets.

visual_rules.layout: one dominant idea per page; real grid and consistent margins

reuse_guidance: Use as baseline quality bar for every client-facing visual artifact. Use with client-local overlay before production.
notes: Baseline placeholder should be replaced with client-approved assets/rules before production.

name: HTML/CSS/SVG + Brave screenshot production lane
not_for: assets that need manual vector path editing unless SVG is clean
why_it_works: Deterministic, editable, source-controlled, brand-constrained, and screenshot-verifiable.

visual_rules.motion: only if artifact requires it and can be previewed

reuse_guidance: Use as safest non-slop visual production lane. Do not ship without inspecting rendered screenshot.
notes: Golden export should describe command pattern generically rather than agency-local absolute paths.

name: Draw.io diagram workhorse
not_for: premium editorial hero visuals without further design treatment
why_it_works: Reliable CLI export to PNG/SVG with editable .drawio source.

visual_rules.color: restrained palette; use color sparingly for state

reuse_guidance: Default for structured diagrams when reliability matters more than art direction.

name: Mermaid fast internal diagram lane
not_for: premium public brand visuals unless restyled or redrawn
why_it_works: Fast structured diagram generation; weaker as final art direction.
reuse_guidance: Use for quick structure; redraw in Draw.io/Paper/HTML for public visuals if needed.
notes: Needs a configured browser/Puppeteer executable in some environments.

name: Editable SVG/logo generation rule
why_it_works: Rejects raster-only logo slop and demands editable vector layers, clean paths, coordinate consistency, and reliable fills.

visual_rules.typography: text must remain editable or intentionally outlined
visual_rules.color: fills must be visible and inspectable
visual_rules.imagery: clean vector paths over raster blobs

reuse_guidance: AI-generated logo/icon work is useful only if it lands as clean editable vector layers. Raster-only logo generation is rejected by default.
notes: Tool candidate remains watch/test; rule is approved.

name: Icon/spot-illustration restraint rule
not_for: premium editorial visuals unless heavily constrained
why_it_works: Prevents agents from defaulting to cute colorful SaaS illustration when the brand calls for restrained direction.
reuse_guidance: Isometric/illustration icon generators are allowed only for secondary support visuals; they must be restrained, editable/exportable, and brand-aligned.
notes: BnbIcons-style references are watch/test, not a default premium editorial brand direction.

name: Reference-driven AI website build workflow
why_it_works: Reference → design pass → code build → browser preview → iteration is stronger than generic prompt-to-page generation.

visual_rules.layout: derive structure, do not clone protected composition exactly
visual_rules.color: brand tokens over reference colors unless approved

reuse_guidance: Use public/client-approved references as inspiration and structure, not as copy targets.
notes: Workflow approved direction; exact toolchain should be tested per project.

name: Creative methodology routing for agent ideation
best_for: choosing a creative frame before production
producing multiple distinct directions from the same brief
not_for: replacing brand constraints or QA gates
copying a named artist's protected style directly
why_it_works: Instead of asking an agent for a generic design idea, route the brief through a named creative methodology or design-thinking lens, then constrain the output back through feasibility, brand safety, and production QA.

visual_rules.layout: select the concept frame first, then translate into channel-specific layout rules
visual_rules.typography: derive mood and hierarchy from the selected methodology, but obey brand fonts and readability
visual_rules.color: use the methodology for palette direction only after brand constraints are known
visual_rules.imagery: prefer own/licensed assets; use references as inspiration, not copy targets
visual_rules.motion: use only when the chosen concept and channel benefit from it

reuse_guidance: Add an ideation step before visual production: generate 3-5 concept directions using distinct methodologies, choose one, then pass it into the normal visual-reference production lane and QA gates.
notes: Captured from Nous Research post describing a creative-ideation skill that routes prompts through 22 creative methodologies to balance feasibility and creativity. Treat as a workflow pattern to adapt into fleet visual/artifact generation, not as a dependency on the specific Nous implementation.
